adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the code unconditionally calls `i.content.scrub` (`content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`), which will raise `NoMethodError` if `i.content` is nil (no nil-guard). Separately, lib/topic_retriever.rb calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline in `perform_retrieve` with no rescue; any exception in PollFeed will abort retrieval before reaching the `fetch_http` fallback.
